A tad short outside off, punched to covers. The batsmen scamper across for a quick run.
Lands it outside off, Hope comes forward and pushes it towards point.
Flatter around middle, Hope goes back but does well to keep it out.
Nudges it through square leg for a single.
Floats it around middle, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Fuller loopy ball around middle and leg, Brathwaite drives it to long on for a single.
Short and spinning away, Kyle goes back and plays it to the deep point fielder for a run.
Kyle Hope defensively pushes it towards covers.
Served outside off, Hope covers the stumps and lets it go.
Floated around off and middle, Hope lunges forward to bunt that.
Lands it just outside off, Brathwaite goes back and slaps it through cover-point for a run.
Drinks! The umpire is having a word with Kyle Hope, not sure about what.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Bowled on the pads, worked away towards fine leg for a brace.

Close! These are the chances that Zimbabwe need to take if they want to rattle the opposition. Williams floats it around off, Hope looks to defend but he gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs towards silly point who dives but fails to get close to the ball. Kyle is surviving some nervy moments here.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Hope sweeps and earns himself a boundary! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Hope gets down and nails the shot through backward square leg. It races away to the fence.

Not Out! Kyle Hope survives! Williams floats it around middle and leg, the batsman gets down to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is unmoved. They discuss and the keeper seems gung-ho about the chance. They opt for the DRS. Hawk Eye shows that it would have gone on to clip the leg stump. The on-field call stays and hence Hope stays on. The hosts do not lose the review though.
Is it out? Cremer thinks so. Williams has pinged Hope in front of the stumps and is confident that it is out. Looks close. Let's see.
FOUR! This is a gift in such conditions! Cremer bowls a full toss in line of the stumps, Brathwaite is too good to miss out. Flicks it away through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter around off, Kraigg goes back and keeps it out.
Looped up around off, Brathwaite lunges forward and smothers the spin.
Shorter around off, Brathwaite hangs back and cuts it towards point.
Kyle drives it to long on for one run.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Hope goes back to defend and does so towards short leg.
Served in line of the stumps, Brathwaite displays a solid front foot defense.
Brathwaite lunges forward to keep this out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Landed around off, Brathwaite fails to flick it away. Gets rapped on the pads. Draws a stifled appeal from the close-in fielders but the bowler walks back to his mark disinterested.
Brathwaite gets nicely forward to defend that.
Flatter around middle and off, blocked off the back foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Kyle Hope is off the mark in style! Cremer floats it around middle and leg, the batsman uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
This ball is defended from the crease.
This is clever cricket. He rotates the strike after getting a boundary. Plays it towards mid on and crosses over to the other end.
SIX! Well, Brathwaite has had enough of blocking them and he wants to smash some! Tossed up delivery around off, he charges down and hits it high and handsome over long on for a biggie.
Floated in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Hope gets beaten again as he lunges forward to defend. Williams is going through a good spell here.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Similar delivery around off, the ball turns past the prodding bat of Hope. This time the keeper collects it well.
Beauty! That one turns square! Looped up around off, Kraigg Brathwaite lunges forward in defense. But the ball spins past the edge to the keeper, who fails to collect that and concedes a bye.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated in line of the stumps, Brathwaite strides forward to defend.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.

Dropped but a tough chance though! This is bowled around middle and leg, Hope flicks it straight to short leg who fails to latch on to that. It came off the middle of the bat and so the first reaction of the fielder was to get out of the way and hence he could not hold onto the chance.
Looped up around off, Hope gets it off the outer half towards point.
Kyle Hope comes out to bat. He averages just over 8 in Test cricket. Safe to say, he is playing for his spot.

OUT! Knocked him over! What a ball that is! Floated around off, the ball doesn't turn as much as Powell expects. He lunges forward to play and the ball beats him on the outer edge to hit the off pole. The Zimbabwe players are ecstatic with the early breakthrough. Don't think Kieran could have done anything better.

FOUR! Powell isn't going to let Cremer settle. Tossed up ball around off and middle, Powell flicks it off his pads through mid-wicket. Waller rushes to his right from the deep and puts in the slide yet fails to prevent the boundary.
Doesn't get the hat-trick! Brathwaite comes down and flicks it away towards wide mid on and crosses over.
Spin from both ends now. Graeme Cremer brings himself on from the other end. He is on a hat-trick!
Landed outside off, Powell goes back to defend but gets a soft edge towards first slip.
Spiteful turn! Williams floats it around off, Powell goes back to cut. But the ball spins in sharply to catch the inside edge of the bat and lands just near short leg.
Looped up outside off, Powell looks to cut but gets beaten.
A tad short around off, the batsman goes back and pushes it towards covers for a run.
Loopy ball around off, Kraigg strides forward to defend.
Tosses it up to the batsman, Brathwaite hits it straight back to the bowler.
Again on a similar line and length, Powell hits it towards mid-wicket.
Bowled on a length around off, Powell negotiates it from the crease.
Landed around off, Powell blocks it from the crease.
Length ball outside off, Kieran thinks of playing initially  but then shoulders arms to let the ball pass to the keeper.
On a length outside off, the ball bounced a bit more after pitching. Powell points his bat skywards to let it go.
Jarvis comes round the wicket and spears it full outside off. Powell drives it to covers.
A tad short outside off, cut away to point.
Brathwaite lunges forward and drives it straight to mid off.
Now Brathwaite gets beaten on the outside edge. Bowled around off, the ball spins away past the prodding bat of Kraigg.
That's why he's bowling here. Lands it around off, Brathwaite strides forward to defend but gets it high on the bat. The ball just drops short of the silly point fielder.
Tossed up around middle, hit straight to mid-wicket.
Serves it on the pads from over the wicket, Powell goes back to clip it towards fine leg for a run.
Spin time! Sean Williams is brought into the attack. He was more than handy in the first innings. Can he get a breakthrough here?
Bowled outside off, driven straight to the mid off fielder.
Very good shot but doesn't get any run for that. Full ball lands around off and middle, Brathwaite drives it straight down. It is intercepted by the mid on fielder.
Hurled outside off, left alone by Kraigg.
Fuller around off, Brathwaite flicks it towards mid-wicket, where the fielder dives and prevents the ball from passing him.
A slower off cutter around off, Powell turns it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a quick single. Gets it easily in the end.
Jarvis continues from over the wicket and bowls it outside off, Powell shows no intentions of playing that.
Powell drives it nicely through covers for a run.
This is bowled outside off, Powell points his bat skywards as he lets that go.
Speared full and wide outside off, Powell doesn't bother playing at that.
Mpofu changes his angles and comes round the wicket. Bowls it around off, Kieran stays in the crease and defends it.

SIX! Hello, oh hello! Where did that come from? Fuller length around off, Powell just hits it over wide long off for a maximum with a push on the up. It was just an extension of the drive, all with a straight bat. Beautifully played. This is the first time he has gone big against a pacer in Tests!
Good judgement by Powell. Mpofu hurls it just outside off, the batsman reads the line well and shoulders arms to that. Wasn't too far from the woodwork behind.
Full length ball just outside off, Brathwaite looks to defend but gets an outside edge past the diving gully fielder. Result, a couple of runs to the tally.
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven towards mid on.
Bowled around middle and leg, played towards mid-wicket.
On a length around middle, defended towards mid on.

Peach! How did Jarvis not get a wicket off this? Bowled on a length around off angling in to the batsman, the ball straightens after pitching. Brathwaite plays for the initial angle and ends up getting beaten. On another day, he would have been caught behind.
Full delivery around off and middle, Brathwaite defends it from the crease.
In the air but well wide of mid off. Mpofu spears it full outside off, Powell drives it off the front foot. Cremer chases it and keeps the batsmen down to two.
On a length around off, Powell stands tall and defends it towards covers.
Landed around off, pushed back towards the bowler.
This delivery is flicked off the pads to fine leg for a single.
Mpofu straightens his line and bowls it around middle and leg, Kraigg clips it in front of square on the leg side and collects a couple.
Bowled outside off, Brathwaite pushes this defensively towards covers.
Fuller ball around off, Powell mistimes his drive, which is stopped by the bowler.
Bowled in line of the stumps, Powell defends it from the crease.
Well played. Hurled outside off, Powell strides and drives it beautifully through covers. Not much power there and so he gets a brace only.
Speared fuller around off and middle, Kieran mistimes his drive down the ground. The fielder from mid off rushes to his left and cuts that off.
Hurled fuller around off, Powell strides forward to defend it showing the full face of the bat.
Angled across the left hander, Powell shoulders arms to let that go.
Pitched up to the batsman, Brathwaite blocks it solidly. A maiden to start for Mpofu.
Brathwaite stands on the back foot and defends this length ball.
On a length outside off, Kraigg watches the ball fly to the keeper.
Fuller in line of the stumps, kept out by Brathwaite from the crease.
Fuller around off, Kraigg strides forward and blocks.
Mpofu begins with a delivery outside off, Brathwaite points his bat skywards as he let that go.
Christopher Mpofu will share the new ball from the other end.
Similar delivery outside off, Powell just lets it be. A good start for Zimbabwe with the ball, as Jarvis almost got rid of Powell early in the over.
Powell shoulders arms to this harmless bowl outside off.
This ball is bowled outside off, left alone by Powell.
This delivery is pushed towards mid-wicket from the crease.

What happened there? Full on the pads, Powell looks to clip it away but gets a leading edge towards mid off. Cremer rushes ahead and dives but the ball falls well short of him. He knocks the stumps down at the bowler's end though. All's safe.
Off the mark straightaway! Jarvis runs in from over the wicket and spears it full around middle, Brathwaite gets it off the inside half of his bat through backward square leg for a run.
